title: Farmers market stall fee
naturalLanguageRequirements: A vendor pays 40 dollars for one stall on a market Saturday, and the fee is due before the stall is set up. The amount and the due time are stated. No second stall fee is left open.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Assign a stall

A vendor pays 40 dollars for one stall on a market Saturday. The fee is due before the stall is set up.

# Data Resources

## Stall

The stall records the vendor and the Saturday.

# Constraints

## Stated fee

The stall fee is 40 dollars, due before setup. This rule is fully stated.
qualityNotes: Clear control: the 40-dollar stall fee and the due time (before setup) are stated. Asking the vendor to pick a different fee is a false clarification.
